title: Model Anchor Composer — compact overlay for selection, pin audits, and profile diffs
creator: Rohan Mehta
description: Build a compact, keyboard-first overlay (Model Anchor Composer) that lets engineers and platform operators quickly select a model version, audit pinned bindings, and view concise performance-profile diffs without leaving the route or dashboard context. This composer should be a low-friction surface for fast pin changes (canary, full pin, rollback), publishing small performance snapshots, and surfacing risk signals (latency regressions, token-cost delta). The overlay is intended to complement — not replace — the full version manager/curation workbench.
acceptance_criteria: Overlay accessible from model route and from per-route actions menu
Shows current pinned version and last published performance snapshot with timestamp and author
Allows selecting a candidate version and previewing computed perf deltas (p50 latency, median cost/token, failure rate) side-by-side
Supports quick pin actions: canary (percentage slider), full pin, schedule pin (datetime), and rollback to previous pin
Includes an audit trail link that opens the pin history in the console and a button to publish a lightweight performance profile (title + metrics + optional notes)
Keyboard shortcuts: open overlay ("K"), confirm action, and close — with accessible focus trap and screen-reader labels
Backend API contract documented: endpoints to fetch latest profiles, compute candidate deltas, and submit pin commands (stubbed for engineering)
